findings: Audit log event mismatch — EVENT_USER_CREATED is used to record organization creation, conflating org-creation events with user-creation events. Use EVENT_SECURITY_ALERT with a descriptive metadata["action"], or add EVENT_ORGANIZATION_CREATED.

Missing test: Restaurant Owner without organization.create → 403. The brief requires this scenario (scenario 5); the existing unauthorized-user test uses a plain user with no role, not a Restaurant Owner.
Missing test: audit log entry written on successful creation (scenario 11). No test asserts SecurityAuditLog.objects.filter(metadata__action="organization_created").exists().
Missing test: atomic rollback when perform_create fails after serializer.save() (scenario 12). The @transaction.atomic added in this diff has no test coverage.

Serializer fallback returns None instead of 0. get_restaurant_count uses a conditional expression that returns None when restaurant_count_annotated is present but None. Use the or-chaining pattern from RestaurantSerializer instead.

Soft test assertion on restaurant-list isolation. test_restaurant_list_for_org_a_returns_org_a_restaurants_only accepts (200, 404); scoped queryset behavior is deterministic and should assert only HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND.

Frontend error type cast suppresses future type safety. The catch block casts err to a plain object; replace with Axios isAxiosError guard and AxiosError<Record<string, unknown>> to prevent silent fallback when a non-object error body is received.
